digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate; seeded-defect measurement / E2 experiment
propositions: Deterministic mutant corpus and benchmark harness seams (mutation-assembly, store-clone isolation, run-validity guard, counting helpers, golden tests) were designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally not landed on main because the harness only drives the rejected LLM batch.

The ~100-run live gate sweep baseline (e2_baseline.json, e2_run_validity.json, e2_verdicts.jsonl) is permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by story d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder, which accumulates detection/blocking-FP signal from real production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.
History-based baseline mining is infeasible: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed, due to stranding from the impact_model_version bump.

Five defect classes are seeded mechanically (absent asserted capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, untagged operational AC) with ≥10 mutants per class (class 5 degrades to ≥5) paired with control rows, all built deterministically without LLM adjudication.

Store isolation is implemented by construction: the harness clones the store standalone with its own .git directory, asserting standalone-ness before injection to prevent real .tickets-tracker contamination.

Counting helpers classify INDETERMINATE verdicts as false negatives not false positives using multi-criteria set-intersection attribution, with a ≥0.20 INDETERMINATE run-validity cap enforced by the emit_baseline guard.
